name: 4-Separating Line Voxelization
definition: A method to generate a discrete representation of a 2D line that is 4-separating (no 4-holes) and 4-minimal (no redundant voxels).
summary: 4-Separating Line Voxelization generates topologically correct, minimal 2D line representations by dynamically calculating a thickness threshold based on the line's angle relative to the grid axes.
